svg.title: A good gradient and four common problems. Good: a smooth blend, dabbed, with a soft overlap. Streaks: lines left by wiping the sponge instead of dabbing. Hard line: the two colors meet in a sharp edge because they were not overlapped. Patchy: white gaps from a dry sponge or too few dabs. Muddy: yellow and purple, opposite colors, turn brownish where they overlap.
